pairs: Of David, with the inscription of a title,
cum fugeret a facie Saul in speluncam.
when he fled from Saul into a cave.
quoniam in te confidit anima mea.
For my soul trusts in you.
Et in umbra alarum tuarum sperabo,
And I will hope in the shadow of your wings,
I will cry out to God Most High,
to God who has been kind to me.
Misit de cælo, et liberavit me;
He sent from heaven and freed me.
dedit in opprobrium conculcantes me. Misit Deus misericordiam suam et veritatem suam,
He has surrendered into disgrace those who trampled me. God has sent his mercy and his truth.
et eripuit animam meam de medio catulorum leonum.
And he has rescued my soul from the midst of the young lions.
their teeth are weapons and arrows,
and their tongue is a sharp sword.
et in omnem terram gloria tua.
and your glory above all the earth.
They prepared a snare for my feet,
and they bowed down my soul.
They dug a pit before my face,
yet they have fallen into it.
and I will compose a psalm.
I will arise in early morning.
I will confess to you, O Lord,
Domine, et psalmum dicam tibi in gentibus:
among the peoples. I will compose a psalm to you among the nations.
quoniam magnificata est usque ad cælos misericordia tua,
For your mercy has been magnified, even to the heavens,
et usque ad nubes veritas tua.
and your truth, even to the clouds.
et super omnem terram gloria tua.
and your glory above all the earth.
